Farmapram 1mg with 30 tablets​ is a one-month supply of high-strength alprazolam medication for moderate to severe anxiety and panic disorders. Manufactured by Ifa Celtics, S.A. de C.V. in Mexico, each bottle contains 30 tablets of 1mg alprazolam, providing effective relief for significant anxiety symptoms.

Dosage Information

With Farmapram 1mg with 30 tablets​, typical dosing includes:
